Legal status describes the legal rights , duties and obligations of a person or entity , or a subset of those rights and obligations. [ 1 ] [ 2 ] The term may be used to describe a person's legal condition with respect to personal rights, but excluding proprietary relations, such as their having the status of a spouse. It may also refer to legal capacity apart from other elements of personal status, such as the status of a minor , [ 1 ] [ 3 ] or the set of privileges , obligations , powers or restrictions that a person or entity receives through legislation . [ 4 ]
